subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions an then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All W are S.

II. No D is W.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some S are W.

II. All S are D.

III. No W is D.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follows
Both conclusions I and II follows
